targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-475b (Q-040.c, first-ever queuing of this mechanism-quantification sub-question): precondition_unmet correctly flagged (P2 dACC engagement: 0/6 runs across 3 seeds x 2 arms had any dACC firing at all -- n_dacc_fires=0, dacc_bias_nonzero_steps=0 universally). Root cause identified by code trace, not left as an unexplained gate failure: the driver's `_build_arm_config` calls `experiments/_lib/goal_pipeline_tier1.build_config(env, gap4_arm)` WITHOUT passing `enable_affective_harm_stream=True`. That parameter defaults False and gates the ENTIRE code block that sets `use_harm_stream=True`/`use_affective_harm_stream=True`/`z_harm_a_dim=...` on the gap4-operating branch -- so z_harm_a stayed structurally None on every tick, and dACC's own invocation guard in ree_core/agent.py (`self.dacc is not None and z_harm_a is not None`) never once fired. build_config's own docstring names this exact failure mode by its 2026-06-01 precedent (V3-EXQ-620/V3-EXQ-625). P1 (gate-firing) PASSED cleanly (2/3 seeds), confirming MECH-269b's V_s-rollout-gating itself engaged correctly -- the defect is isolated to the harm-stream config omission, nothing upstream. Not a substrate ceiling, not evidence bearing on Q-040c's actual question (whether dACC bias magnitude tracks precision-weighted PE under V_s gating). Recommend same-question re-queue (V3-EXQ-475c) with the one-line fix (`build_config(env, gap4_arm, enable_affective_harm_stream=True)`), plus a smoke-test assertion that n_dacc_fires > 0 before the full run, to catch this class of defect before spending compute on it again.
learning_extracted: P2 (dACC engagement) failing at exactly 0/N across every seed and arm is a strong signal of a structural precondition never being met at all, not a marginal/noisy near-miss -- worth checking the config wiring before assuming 'insufficient signal'.

The gap4-operating branch of build_config() requires an explicit enable_affective_harm_stream=True opt-in that the non-gap4 (from_dims) branch enables unconditionally -- an asymmetry the module's own docstring flags as a known footgun, and this driver walked into it despite the warning being right there.
P1 passing cleanly while P2 fails completely is informative: the upstream V_s-gating substrate (MECH-269b) is fine; the defect is isolated to a single downstream config flag.
A quick smoke-test assertion (n_dacc_fires > 0) before a full run would have caught this in minutes instead of after the full 3-seed x 2-arm run completed.
